verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a doola feature that lets users define their own event-triggered rules or automations. Signed webhooks (doola-docs-7) and sandbox webhook firing (doola-docs-3) are developer building blocks that a partner would need to wire into their own automation. Pulse's bookkeeping automation and the compliance calendar are adjacent features, not configurable rule engines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
